$comment: THE hand-written part. Meta publishes no machine-readable Graph API spec, so every fact is grounded in its Content Publishing documentation.
title: Instagram for Business

authorize.$comment: Meta documents the token as a query parameter. appsecret_proof travels beside it so installations requiring App Secret Proof do not reject every call.

proof.$comment: HMAC-SHA256 over the access token, keyed by the app secret.

oauth.$refreshTokenRotates: Facebook Login issues no refresh token, so there is nothing to rotate. The connection is re-authorized instead.
oauth.$scopeComment: instagram_content_publish permits both publishing edges; instagram_basic identifies the professional account; pages_read_engagement is required alongside the Page-linked account flow.

$sandboxComment: CHECKED. Meta provides no separate publishing host, credentials or test estate. media_publish creates a real post; container creation creates a real temporary object that expires after 24 hours.
sandboxNote: Instagram publishing has no sandbox. Publishing creates a real post on a real professional account, and an unpublished container expires after 24 hours.
$baseUrlComment: The Graph API version is a path segment. Pinning v25.0 avoids Meta's unversioned selection of an older supported version.
